content: {"summary":"Customers are frustrated that the letter “I” is being replaced or distorted, causing typing errors and confusion. They report seeing the character appear in a cube or as “A ⍰”, and that the autocorrect is substituting “L” for “l” when using “I”. Users feel the issue is ignored and that the fix is delayed, leading to annoyance and a perception of poor quality. Each complaint highlights the same core problem of letter‑specific typing errors.
